replies.body:
Hi Lisa,

Thanks for reaching out. Do you want to write a letter to the editor in
response? Here are the specs ....

https://www.marinij.com/2013/07/18/how-to-submit-a-letter-to-the-editor/

Please stay in touch,
Dave

On Sat, Sep 5, 2026 at 11:09 PM Lisa Monelli <info@myvilla.la> wrote:

> Hello,
>
> Wanted to follow up in case my note last week slipped through given
> how busy the newsroom can get. One data point that struck us as
> relevant to your piece: LA County permits for noncombustible
> residential construction have risen sharply since 2025, suggesting the
> market is starting to bend toward what your column argued for. Happy
> to share the underlying data if useful for a follow-up.
>
> Best,
> Lisa Monelli
> My Villa Media Team
> info@myvilla.la · myvilla.la
>


-- 
* Dave Allen *
  Digital Editor/Opinion Editor | Marin Independent Journal
  dallen@marinij.com
  415.382.7206 Direct |

<https://www.marinij.com> <https://www.bayareanewsgroup.com>
